answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 9775 Country: QA Title: Mane apne bete ka naam hmza rkha hai iske maane keya hai yeh naam sahi hai ki nehi jawab irsal frmaye allah hafiz Question: Mane apne bete ka naam hmza rkha hai iske maane keya hai yeh naam sahi hai ki nehi jawab irsal frmaye allah hafiz Answer ID: 9775 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1695/1398=L/1429) Hamzah means: lion. It is correct to keep this name. Hamzah was the uncle of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) who was martyred in the Uhud War and who is called ?Syedus Shuhada? (the head of all martyrs). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
